# Beta-Binomial: alpha counts successes, beta counts failures,
# so the update is addition.
a0 <- 1; b0 <- 1        # prior Beta(1, 1)
s  <- 7; n  <- 10        # 7 successes in 10 trials

a1 <- a0 + s          # posterior alpha
b1 <- b0 + n - s      # posterior beta
c(a1, b1)
#> [1] 8 4

a1 / (a1 + b1)                 # posterior mean
#> [1] 0.6666667
qbeta(0.5, a1, b1)             # posterior median
#> [1] 0.6761955
qbeta(c(0.025000000000000022, 0.975), a1, b1)   # 95% credible interval
#> [1] 0.3902574 0.8907366

# Normal-Normal with sigma known: precisions add.
m0 <- 100; s0 <- 50        # prior Normal(100, 50^2)
xbar <- 112; n <- 25; sigma <- 15

prec0 <- 1 / s0^2     # prior precision
precD <- n / sigma^2  # data precision
s1 <- sqrt(1 / (prec0 + precD))                      # posterior SD
m1 <- (m0 * prec0 + xbar * precD) / (prec0 + precD)  # posterior mean
m1
#> [1] 111.957
s1
#> [1] 2.994615

qnorm(c(0.025000000000000022, 0.975), m1, s1)   # 95% credible interval
#> [1] 106.0876 117.8263

# Gamma-Poisson: the prior carries a0 events over b0 exposure.

y  <- 12; t  <- 10        # 12 events over 10 of exposure

a1 <- a0 + y          # posterior shape
b1 <- b0 + t          # posterior rate
c(a1, b1)
#> [1] 12.001 10.001

a1 / b1                                          # posterior mean
#> [1] 1.19998
qgamma(0.5, shape = a1, rate = b1)               # posterior median
